![GitHub Release](https://github.com/Kyliekyler/MAGNETAR/tree/release) ![GitHub Release](https://github.com/Kyliekyler/MAGNETAR/tree/pre-release)

Description

Device Performance Optimizer — Aims To Provide An Optimal Experience At Every Usage Scenario

MAGNETAR is an all-in-one kernel tweaker that aims to provide an optimal experience in all usage scenarios for all rooted devices. It automatically controls the device using Machine Learning to adapt to the user's usage. A variety of features are also available to fit the user's preferences.

Getting Started

MAGNETAR requires the following to function properly:

  • [![API 21+](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-21%2B-3DDC84.svg?style=flat&logo=android)](https://www.android.com/)
  • [![ARM arm64](https://img.shields.io/badge/ARM-arm64-0091BD.svg?style=flat&logo=arm)](https://www.arm.com/)
  • [![Magisk 26404+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Magisk-26404%2B-00B39B.svg?style=flat&logo=magisk)](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk) [![KernelSU 11422+](https://img.shields.io/badge/KernelSU-11422%2B-1E110D.svg?style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU) [![APatch 10472+](https://img.shields.io/badge/APatch-10472%2B-37DA94.svg?style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://github.com/bmax121/APatch)

    • Once the system has been confirmed to meet MAGNETAR criteria, it may be flashed via the root app manager and rebooted to take effect.

    Downloads

    The official MAGNETAR files can only be obtained from Github & Pling.

    ![Github](https://github.com/Kyliekyler/MAGNETAR/releases) ![Pling](https://pling.com/p/1465345)

    Wiki

    Official MAGNETAR information can be found on MAGNEPEDIA.

    ![MAGNEPEDIA](https://github.com/Kyliekyler/MAGNETAR/wiki)

    Bug Reports

    Only bug reports that are related to MAGNETAR will be accepted.

    Report any such issues or bugs that may occur using magnetar --bugreport or Github Issues. Give a thorough explanation of the problem so that it can be resolved as soon as possible. Bug reports will be automatically routed to the bugreport channel.

    License

    MAGNETAR is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International



    MAGNETAR © 2019-2025
